documents.text: Global Tech Summit registration opens at 8:00 AM.
Global Tech Summit Hall A is on Level 1.
VIP sponsors at Global Tech Summit have lounge access.
Global Tech Summit cancellation is allowed 72 hours before the event.
Hospitality Leadership Forum registration opens at 9:00 AM.
Hospitality Leadership Forum Hall C is on Level 3.
Hospitality Leadership Forum does not provide lounge access.
Hospitality Leadership Forum cancellation is allowed 48 hours before the event.
